hints.content:
The **constant of proportionality** is the value of $y$ when $x=1$ in a proportional relationship.

On which line does $y=6$ when $x=1$?

[[☃ image 1]]

Line $\blueD{A}$ has a constant of proportionality of $6$ between $x$ and $y$.

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes both scale by one. The graphs of three lines intersect. A graph of a line labeled A intersects the points (0, 0) and (1, 6). A graph of a line labeled B intersects the points (0, 0) and (3, 5). A graph of a line labeled C intersects the points (0, 0) and (6, 3). There is a point on line A at (1, 6).
